source: Clementine UVVIS 750 nm global mosaic v2.1, 118 m/px (USGS Astrogeology)
meaning: relative albedo at 750 nm (grey, linear DN 0-255 as published); use as a brightness multiplier, not as colour
frame: terrain-v3 tileset frame (x east, y north, origin at the LM); row 0 = north edge
resampling: GDAL cubic from 118 m to 80 m (no new detail; upsampled)
